import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *
CS = cfg(accounts=[{"id":"a","default":"sips:sec@lab.test","aliases":["sips:sec@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}],
         peers=[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]},{"id":"relay","mode":"relay","accounts":["a"]}])
check("sips default", env(CS, [ev(0,"edge","a","internal",basic_req(frm="sips:sec@lab.test;tag=t"))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","account":"a","identity":"sips:sec@lab.test","from":"sips:sec@lab.test","pai":["sips:sec@lab.test"]}])
check("sips ppi tel", env(CS, [ev(0,"edge","a","internal",basic_req(frm="sips:sec@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>, <sips:sec@lab.test>")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","identity":"sips:sec@lab.test","pai":["sips:sec@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}])
check("sips target to mismatch", env(CS, [ev(0,"edge","a","internal",basic_req(uri="sips:bob@lab.test",to="<sip:bob@lab.test>"))]), ["fields"])
check("relay sips pai", env(CS, [ev(0,"relay",None,"internal",basic_req(frm="sips:sec@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>"),("P-Asserted-Identity","<sips:sec@lab.test>")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","account":"a","identity":"sips:sec@lab.test","pai":["sips:sec@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}])

check("pai row sips+tel", env(CS, [ev(0,"relay",None,"internal",basic_req(frm="sips:sec@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sips:sec@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept"}])
# privacy id + ppi
check("ppi + privacy id", env(CS, [ev(0,"edge","a","external",basic_req(frm="sips:sec@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>"),("Privacy","id")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","identity":"tel:+12025550100","from":"sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid","pai":[],"privacy":"id"}])

check("relay allowed bob", env(C2, [ev(0,"relay",None,"internal",basic_req(frm="sip:bob@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:bob@lab.test>")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","account":"bob","identity":"sip:bob@lab.test"}])
# 256 aliases? max 8 per account, 256 accounts
many = [{"id":"a%03d"%i,"default":"sip:u%d@x.test"%i,"aliases":["sip:u%d@x.test"%i]} for i in range(256)]
